entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.35.0.5 to 30.35.0.7 (fork commit `4239b4821b57`, upstream v30.35.0), a verified delivery of the benchbox-sqlglot fork that adds the `exact_decimal_quotients` engine rewrite.

The `exact_decimal_quotients` rewrite is registered as a TPC-DI query-adapter rule for DuckDB, which divides DECIMAL operands as scaled integers instead of in DOUBLE so a quotient cast to DECIMAL rounds half-cent ties away from zero.
